defect: Fixed: TrustPlan has no separate reload field; reload() is derived on demand from the classified TrustRevocationState's carried cadence, so the call site reads the witness X4 validated.
evidence: trust_plan.rs:60-67 (reload is not a field; derived from revocation state), :115-116, :132-137 (trust_reload_plan matches state.reload_cadence()); trust_plane/mod.rs:296 reads plan.reload().
title: The call site reads plan.reload, not the cadence witness the classified state carries
